messages:
Alex: Quick sync — starlore trial readiness for this week. Deliverables: network config + model adapter. Who owns the firewall request?
Maria (SE): I raised the firewall ticket (NET-4321) yesterday, pending infra approval. I'll chase today.
Devon (PM): Owner for adapter is Snehit? Need ETA for staging integration by Wed.
Snehit: yep that's me. Plan: PR today, integration tests tomorrow. Might need a small schema tweak from Starlore's API — pinged their devs.
Chris (Solutions): Confirming success criteria: 1) inference p95 < 300ms in staging; 2) VPC connectivity; 3) eval pass rate >= 92%. Agree? :thumbsup: 
Alex: aligned. Also need the test dataset from Starlore — @Chris can you confirm they sent it?
Chris (Solutions): They uploaded a config tar last night — link: https://fileshare.example.com/starlore/starlore-dataset.tar.gz (team-only)
Maria (SE): NET-4321 is "awaiting infra". tagging @DeployBot for infra queue.
DeployBot: Ticket NET-4321 routed to infra-queue. Estimated SLA: 2 business days.
Snehit: If infra takes 2 days, schedule risk. Fallback idea: temporary VPN tunnel from their side for staging. Less ideal but faster.
Devon (PM): If infra delays, fallback = vendor VPN + ephemeral creds. Need security signoff. @Snehit can you draft a short VPN runbook/checklist?
Snehit: will draft and post here by EOD.
Alex: Also need code review for adapter PR — can we get eng-runtime eyes? @Maria any suggested reviewers?
Maria (SE): flagged Priya and Ben — they should have bandwidth.
Priya: can review after lunch.
Ben: can take a quick pass now.
Snehit: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/adapter-starlore/merge_requests/58 — includes schema change. Tests included.
Devon (PM): Timeline check: PR + review today, staging integration tomorrow, perf run Wed, go/no-go Thurs.
Alex: I'll update the trial timeline doc and notify sales. Also adding a short checklist:

```
Pre-integration checklist:
- NET-4321 resolved or VPN fallback
- Adapter PR merged
- Staging creds & dataset in place
- Smoke eval pass (>90%)
```

Chris (Solutions): For perf run, confirm model variant = starlore-v2-q4 on 8xA100 cluster?
Maria (SE): correct.
Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll post infra updates once NET-4321 changes. :thumbsup:
